execution.reason: Qualification must precede publication, and both implementation tasks share the skill-system contract before integrated verification.

tasks.title: Qualify the pinned source and lock the RED contract
tasks.description: Canonical provenance, license, focused-test evidence, and the failing-then-passing consumer-neutral static contract are recorded without modifying external source.
acceptance_criteria: The exact standalone commit, byte-matched canonical monorepo ref, Apache-2.0 license, canonical type-contract paths, and observed PR CI success, failure, and cancellation results are recorded with the explicit limitation that no template-specific tests exist.
An MCP health probe resolves a known Mastra source symbol and the parent verifies the result against current source bytes.
The static test rejects portfolio coupling, missing clean-code sections, missing source limits, and omission of known anomalies.
Existing RED evidence is recorded truthfully; the absence of template-specific tests remains explicit, and target behavior tests rather than upstream CI alone gate adoption.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="Mastra skill extracts clean source practices" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
tasks.expected_verification_state: The focused target contract and plan qualification check pass; /ship must record the previously observed RED failure, current GREEN result, exact upstream CI exceptions, and parent source verification before this task may pass.

tasks.title: Publish the qualified Mastra clean-code skill
tasks.description: The registered on-demand skill teaches reusable Mastra structure in consumer-neutral terms while explicitly rejecting the template's unqualified shortcuts.
acceptance_criteria: The skill is pinned to the standalone source and explicitly distinguishes it from the full Mastra monorepo.
Composition root, module shape, agents, tools, workflows, shared infrastructure, RAG data contracts, errors, testing, source strengths, anomalies, and adoption checks are detailed.
The skill contains no portfolio coupling, copied application source, hard-coded local path, or claim that the uninstalled template passed.
The manifest contains mastra-development exactly once and retains exact bidirectional parity.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="Mastra skill extracts clean source practices|manifest has exact bidirectional parity" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
tasks.expected_verification_state: Commands exit zero once task-1 qualification evidence is complete and the current detailed skill remains consumer-neutral and registered.

tasks.title: Verify integration and preserve narrow promotion
tasks.description: All repository gates pass with only the detailed skill, its contract, registration, and explicit lifecycle evidence in scope; no corpus or runtime capability is promoted.
acceptance_criteria: All retained tests pass, Doctor reports no failing contract checks, and every artifact graph validates.
No Mastra dependency, copied source tree, or corpus entry is introduced.
Parent review reconciles the complete tracked and untracked worktree while modifying only owned paths.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f" >/dev/null || exit; done
tasks.expected_verification_state: All commands exit zero after tasks 1 and 2 pass; unrelated dirty-worktree paths remain read-only and do not become task evidence.
